lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance pixel clusters posterior to the fifth gill slit are arranged in distinct vertical columns, forming a rectilinear grid with horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form clear grid-like anchor nodes across the posterior gill region and mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, beginning above the gill slits and extending posteriorly, defined by a high-intensity upper highlight and a lower-intensity shadow.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular white cicatrices are visible on the dorsal surface above the gill region, appearing as wide, linear abrasions or healed trauma marks.
other_distinctive_markers: At least four remoras are visible: one attached to the ventral side of the pectoral fin and others trailing beneath the main body mass.
